==Problem==
Carlos Montado was born on Saturday, November 9, 2002. On what day of the week will Carlos be <imath>706</imath> days old? 

<imath> \text{(A)}\ \text{Monday}\qquad\text{(B)}\ \text{Wednesday}\qquad\text{(C)}\ \text{Friday}\qquad\text{(D)}\ \text{Saturday}\qquad\text{(E)}\ \text{Sunday} </imath>

==Solution 1==

After <imath>700</imath> days, or <imath>100</imath> weeks, it will be Saturday.  Thus after <imath>706</imath> days, it will be <imath>6</imath> days after Saturday, which is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(C)}\ \text{Friday}}</imath>.

==Solution 2==

After <imath>707</imath> days, or <imath>101</imath> weeks, it will be Saturday.  Thus after <imath>706</imath> days, it will be <imath>1</imath> day before Saturday, which is <imath>\boxed{\textbf{(C)}\ \text{Friday}}</imath>.
